\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 193-196 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R201-first-pass-words-from-chapters-193-196}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for sunrise and the end.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to spend, to put money by, to order, to dry, to iron
  \item to phone, to discuss, to forbid, to protect, to die
  \item to warn, to be enough, to burn, to knock, to compare
  \item to go for a walk, to fold, to prepare, to introduce, to lend
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To spend? (\textbf{\mr{खर्च} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{kharc karṇe}.) To put money by? (\textbf{\mr{बचत} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{bacat karṇe}.) To order? (\textbf{\mr{मागवणे}}, \emph{māgavṇe}.) To dry? (\textbf{\mr{वाळवणे}}, \emph{vāḷavṇe}.) To iron? (\textbf{\mr{इस्त्री} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{istrī karṇe}.) To phone? (\textbf{\mr{फोन} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{phon karṇe}.) To discuss? (\textbf{\mr{चर्चा} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{carcā karṇe}.) To forbid? (\textbf{\mr{मनाई} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{manāī karṇe}.) To protect? (\textbf{\mr{रक्षण} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{rakṣaṇ karṇe}.) To die? (\textbf{\mr{मरणे}}, \emph{marṇe}.) To warn? (\textbf{\mr{सावध} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{sāvadh karṇe}.) To be enough? (\textbf{\mr{पुरणे}}, \emph{purṇe}.) To burn? (\textbf{\mr{जळणे}}, \emph{jaḷṇe}.) To knock? (\textbf{\mr{ठोठावणे}}, \emph{ṭhoṭhāvṇe}.) To compare? (\textbf{\mr{तुलना} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{tulnā karṇe}.) To go for a walk? (\textbf{\mr{फिरायला} \mr{जाणे}}, \emph{phirāylā jāṇe}.) To fold? (\textbf{\mr{घडी} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{ghaḍī karṇe}.) To prepare? (\textbf{\mr{तयारी} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{tayārī karṇe}.) To introduce? (\textbf{\mr{ओळख} \mr{करून} \mr{देणे}}, \emph{oḷakh karūn deṇe}.) To lend? (\textbf{\mr{उसने} \mr{देणे}}, \emph{usne deṇe}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 197-201 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R201-second-pass-words-from-chapters-197-201}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to get used to and to hurry.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to get used to, to hurry, to come near, to chat, to deliver
  \item to press, to cough, to tremble, to vote, to welcome
  \item to stick, to reach, to visit, to knit, to harvest
  \item a muscle, a wound, a scar, a head cold, a note; a prescription
  \item until, a decade, sunset, sunrise, the end
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To get used to? (\textbf{\mr{सवय} \mr{होणे}}, \emph{savay hoṇe}.) To hurry? (\textbf{\mr{घाई} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{ghāī karṇe}.) To come near? (\textbf{\mr{जवळ} \mr{येणे}}, \emph{javaḷ yeṇe}.) To chat? (\textbf{\mr{गप्पा} \mr{मारणे}}, \emph{gappā mārṇe}.) To deliver? (\textbf{\mr{पोचवणे}}, \emph{pocavṇe}.) To press? (\textbf{\mr{दाबणे}}, \emph{dābṇe}.) To cough? (\textbf{\mr{खोकणे}}, \emph{khokṇe}.) To tremble? (\textbf{\mr{थरथरणे}}, \emph{thartharṇe}.) To vote? (\textbf{\mr{मत} \mr{देणे}}, \emph{mat deṇe}.) To welcome? (\textbf{\mr{स्वागत} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{svāgat karṇe}.) To stick? (\textbf{\mr{चिकटवणे}}, \emph{cikaṭavṇe}.) To reach? (\textbf{\mr{गाठणे}}, \emph{gāṭhṇe}.) To visit? (\textbf{\mr{भेट} \mr{देणे}}, \emph{bheṭ deṇe}.) To knit? (\textbf{\mr{विणणे}}, \emph{viṇṇe}.) To harvest? (\textbf{\mr{कापणी} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{kāpṇī karṇe}.) A muscle? (\textbf{\mr{स्नायू}}, \emph{snāyū}.) A wound? (\textbf{\mr{जखम}}, \emph{jakham}.) A scar? (\textbf{\mr{व्रण}}, \emph{vraṇ}.) A head cold? (\textbf{\mr{सर्दी}}, \emph{sardī}.) A note; a prescription? (\textbf{\mr{चिठ्ठी}}, \emph{ciṭṭhī}.) Until? (\textbf{\mr{पर्यंत}}, \emph{paryant}.) A decade? (\textbf{\mr{दशक}}, \emph{daśak}.) Sunset? (\textbf{\mr{सूर्यास्त}}, \emph{sūryāsta}.) Sunrise? (\textbf{\mr{सूर्योदय}}, \emph{sūryoday}.) The end? (\textbf{\mr{शेवट}}, \emph{śevaṭ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
